summary: Describes how Mobile IPv6 Fast Handovers can be carried out on networks using the IEEE 802.16e wireless standard, commonly called mobile WiMAX. It tries to achieve seamless handover by using link-layer handover indicators and lining up the 802.16e steps with the Mobile IPv6 steps. This is an informational document, not a standard.

eli5.summary: When a phone moves between towers, the radio part and the internet part must move in step. This explains how to make them work in step on WiMAX, so a switch causes as little interruption as possible.
